_comment: Whole-grid horizontal flip (mirror left<->right). A geometric/dihedral transform: no family matcher recognises it (object_motion declines - the whole scene moves, not one object; constant_output declines - outputs differ; object_recolor/colour-map decline - no value changes), so the general Slow-path synthesizer solves it by SEARCH (schema 5: make_grid(in_h,in_w,bg) then paint_remap('flip_h'), a coordinate expression fed to the frozen coloring primitive - NOT a new DSL primitive, per BACKLOG_LOOP.md 2.5-1). Value-agnostic: each cell's colour is copied, only its position changes, so the program transfers unchanged to the test input (P5). Grounds the R3 lift: shares the make_grid+paint_remap skeleton with flip_v.json and rot180.json (same output dims), diverging only in the map leaf, so unify() lifts that leaf to ?v and folds all three into ONE covers=3 rule with a trace (P1/P2/P3 rise together) instead of one rule per transform.
